title: Coordinatewise xor vanishes exactly on equal inputs
statement: Let $y, z \in \bbf_2^n$ be two $n$-bit Boolean strings, and let $y \oplus z$ denote their coordinatewise xor, the string whose $i$-th bit is $y_i \oplus z_i$. Then $y \oplus z$ is the all-zero string if and only if $y = z$.
hypotheses_covered: y, z are n-bit Boolean inputs
replaced: $\mathrm{xorInput}(y, z) = \mathbf{0}$ if and only if $y = z$.
